narrative.overview: "Neon Ledger" is a visual system built around a stark, deliberate contrast between two experiences: a high-energy, Gen Z-inspired learning portal for beginners and a high-density, nerdy terminal dashboard for developers. It bridges approachable education with raw technical utility, avoiding standard corporate design clichés by committing to a dark, high-contrast aesthetic and tactile elements.
keyCharacteristics: High Contrast: Dark background anchored by a piercing neon lime accent.
Bi-modal Density: Generous spacing for conceptual learning, compact grids for developer metrics.
Tactile Shapes: Sharp outlines, thick borders, and flat pill toggles.
Intentional Motion: Snappy scroll reveals and subtle height pulses for simulation elements.

rules.name: The 10% Lime Rule
rules.body: Neon Kinetic Lime is used exclusively as an accent. It must cover no more than 10% of any view to prevent visual fatigue and preserve its utility as an focus-guiding element.

rules.name: The No-Faded-Gray Rule
rules.body: Standard dark gray-on-gray borders are prohibited. Use only Steel Wireframe (#30363d) for structural lines to ensure high-contrast container division.

rules.name: The Text Wrapping Rule
rules.body: Always apply text-wrap: balance on H1-H3 titles to avoid awkward single-word orphans on smaller viewports.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: All cards, inputs, and terminals are completely flat. Drop shadows are forbidden. State changes are communicated via border highlights, background shifts, and neon glow rings.

dos: Do use strict flat containers with Steel Wireframe (#30363d) borders to define boundaries.
Do support snap-scrolling transitions between the 5 structured scenes in both beginner and developer views.
Do maintain a clear visual layout split when toggling between Gen Z beginners and finance-nerd developer console views.
Do ensure all text elements meet WCAG AA contrast standards.
donts: Don't use ambient shadows or glassmorphism effects; stick to the flat tactile aesthetic.
Don't use side-stripe borders greater than 1px on containers or alerts.
Don't use low-contrast text colors or text that overflows view borders on responsive layouts.
Don't animate image scale or rotation on hover; animate container background, borders, or text colors instead.
